description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class 'PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI' for managing the final evaluation of performance reviews within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It provides methods to update and retrieve the final evaluation details, with input validation, authorization checks, and transaction handling.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewFinalEvaluationAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for final evaluation of performance reviews, including updating and retrieving final review data, with validation and authorization controls.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the update request for final performance review evaluation, validates input, updates the review entity, and manages transaction.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a finalized performance review by ID, with validation and access checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update request, including review ID and final evaluation data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a specific review.

methods.name: setFinalEvaluation
methods.description: Sets the final review ratings, comments, and date on the PerformanceReview entity based on request data.

methods.name: getFinalEvaluationBodyParamRules
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for final evaluation related request parameters, optionally marking them as not required based on 'complete' status.
